name: Motile Chameleon
body:
You stay on your toes, even when using your chromatophoric skin to blend in with your surroundings.

Prerequisites: Dex 13, change color racial trait, lizardfolk.

Benefit: You can change color as a standard action. You no longer become flat-footed as a result of changing color.

Book of Heroic Races: Advanced Lizardfolk. © 2015, Jon Brazer Enterprises
